blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A House budget panel’s move to increase funding for the Medical Assistance for Indigent and Financially Incapacitated Patients (MAIFIP) program drew criticism on Tuesday, with several groups saying the additional funds should instead be used to strengthen the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth). Healthcare professionals, budget watchdogs, labor groups and basic sector leaders questioned the Budget Amendments and Review Subcommittee’s (BARSc) decision to raise the MAIFIP allocation for 2027. The groups said the Budget Amendments and Review Subcommittee (BARSc) on Oct. 1 increased the proposed MAIFIP allocation for 2027 from P24 billion to P49 billion. READ: House special […]...
